title: Jacobi Endpoint Pencils and Sharp Interlacing for Centered Binomial Samples
summary: We study interlacing between real polynomial quotients obtained from centered binomial samples of a fixed even or odd real entire function at consecutive odd degrees. For sources of order at most one, we determine the optimal vertical-strip half-widths guaranteeing weak interlacing for every adjacent pair: $\sqrt{15/28}$ for even sources and the explicit algebraic constant $h_*\approx 1.0656$ for odd sources.
